name: Farmers Advancements
summary: Thirty new advancements for crops, animals and farm food in their own tab, so a quiet farm world has goals too.
logoPrompt: A single golden wheat bundle tied with a red ribbon standing on a block of moist farmland, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Thirty goals for your farm, in one new tab.

description: **Farmers Advancements adds a new advancement tab, Farmer's Almanac, with 30 goals for anyone who would rather farm than fight.**
- Planting goals for wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, pumpkins, melons, sweet berries, nether wart, torchflowers and pitcher pods.
- Harvest and animal goals: a full stack of wheat, a basket of eggs, fresh milk and breeding cows, sheep, pigs, chickens and rabbits.
- Farm food and farm tools: bread, pies and soups, hoes and the composter.
- Three challenges: collect every crop, breed every farm animal and eat a full harvest feast. Some advancements give experience, none give items.
Put the zip into the `datapacks` folder of your world (or pick it when you create a new world). Pick up wheat seeds and the new tab opens in the advancements screen.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21 and 1.21.1. It only adds advancements, so it is safe to add to an existing world.
- Works in singleplayer and on servers; players need nothing installed.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
